context: The agent must wire up code generation for a new brick, with bank-schema's existing wiring given as the pattern to mirror. Key discriminator: without the idiom, an agent may hand-roll a shell script or a custom Babashka task to run protoc, or reimplement the generation logic inline in the new brick's build.clj instead of delegating to the shared bases/build; with the idiom loaded, it knows generation always goes through Clojure's standard :deps/prep-lib mechanism with a thin build.clj shim delegating to bases/build, so the logic lives in exactly one place.

checklist.name: build.clj is a thin delegating shim
checklist.description: bank-widget-schema/build.clj defines a fn that calls build.proto/gen-proto, not a reimplementation of proto generation

checklist.name: :deps/prep-lib entry added
checklist.description: deps.edn declares :deps/prep-lib with an :alias, :fn pointing at the new build.clj fn, and an :ensure path

checklist.name: :build alias added
checklist.description: deps.edn's :aliases includes a :build alias bringing in tools.build and bases/build, matching bank-schema's shape

checklist.name: No external build system or shell script introduced
checklist.description: The diff does not add a Makefile, shell script, or Maven/Gradle config for generation

checklist.name: bank-schema and bases/build left unchanged
checklist.description: Neither the existing bank-schema wiring nor bases/build/proto.clj is modified
